name: How long does a typical roof installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical roof installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a roof installation varies depending on several factors, including the size and complexity of your roof, the type of roofing materials chosen, and weather conditions. For an average-sized residential home, a new asphalt shingle roof can typically be installed within 2 to 5 days. More complex projects or specialized materials like tile or metal might extend this timeline. Our team works efficiently while maintaining high standards of quality and safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical residential roof installation usually takes 2 to 5 days, depending on roof size, material, and weather.
